task: Standing trace for automated dependency/action pin bumps (e.g. Dependabot) under .github/workflows/**: what CI verifies so a routine version bump does not need a new hand-written trace per PR

events.summary: A qualifying bump changes only a dependency's pinned reference (and its human-readable version comment) or a dependency manifest/lockfile entry; no job, permission, trigger, or script logic changes
Verified the target action reference was already expressed as an immutable 40-character commit SHA with a version comment before the bump, per the repo's mutable-input policy
Bump replaces the pinned SHA and version comment (or manifest/lockfile version) for the dependency identified by the automated PR; diff is limited to `uses:` pin lines or manifest/lockfile content
check-mutable-inputs.py re-verifies every GitHub Action reference in protected workflows is still a 40-character commit SHA after the bump
Agent Behavior workflow's behavior-contract job (including the dependency-bump exemption in check-agent-trace-requirement.py) and Lint & Validate run unmodified against the bump
Pin-only dependency bumps from a trusted automated author are covered by this standing trace via risk-policy.json's dependencyBumpExemption; any other change still requires its own trace
Complete and verified; this trace is reused across qualifying dependency-bump PRs rather than regenerated per PR
